verdict.rationale: There is no documented export or download-your-data feature. Data portability is only implied: the REST API v2 can programmatically read Scheduling, Contacts and Notetaker data, and webhooks stream event data in real time, so a user could build their own extraction. One community report says leaving was easy (moved to zcal in 30 minutes), which weakly supports low lock-in. Missing for 10: a documented first-party bulk export, explicit open file formats (e.g., CSV/ICS/JSON dumps), coverage of all data types (recordings, transcripts, routing forms, workflows), and account-deletion/offboarding docs.
